purpose: Choose 512 unique real saved frames from the already-defined episode. This contract does not define dissociation, read labels, or select a model.

shared.scale_rule: per-feature MAD of first differences in the first 128 causally smoothed frames, then SD fallback, then 1.0 fallback
shared.multiblock_normalization: divide each scaled block by the square root of its dimension

P512.definition: equal quantiles of cumulative multiblock path arclength, with both episode endpoints forced
input_blocks: separation: pocket geometric COM distance, aligned centroid displacement, global minimum heavy-atom distance
contact: native-contact fraction, global contact-residue count, frozen pocket contact bits
pose: aligned ligand RMSD, ligand internal RMSD, pocket-alignment RMSD
P512.directionality: symmetric; leaving, returning, contact rearrangement, and pose rearrangement all contribute

scientific_boundaries.comment: P512 is the deployment-compatible sampler used by the bundled experimental models. It is not presented as a universal or selected sampler winner.
